svg.text: Depth in Colony Basin. Levee crest 14.5 ft; above it, water spills into Lower Town.
Company forecast (Earth constants): crest 13.3 ft at hour 44
Mars constants, gate shut: at the crest by hour 40.4; 134 million gallons over
Mars constants, gate open hours 38 to 52 (FV run): crest 13.98 ft at hour 54
the same plan, stock dynamic wave: 13.99 ft (under the FV line)
